name: Kirsten Strandjord
research_summary: Strandjord studies satellite navigation, including how to navigate in the region between Earth and the Moon. She investigates navigation signals beyond the usual navigation-satellite orbits and the use of existing Starlink and cellular LTE signals as additional navigation sources.
